discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators and the quantum spin Hall effect
rationale: Topological insulators are a long-standing, highly cited condensed-matter discovery with a clean theory-plus-experiment trio (Kane-Mele Z2 theory, Molenkamp's HgTe quantum well observation), already recognized by the Breakthrough, Dirac and Oliver Buckley prizes; it builds on the 2016 topological phases prize and remains one of the most commonly named unrewarded fields.
